name: Pager
project_description: The Pager module provides a configurable block that adds previous/next navigation between individual nodes. Placed on node pages, the block finds the neighbouring published nodes ordered strictly by node creation time (chronological), restricted to selected content types and selected taxonomy terms, and renders each neighbour as a thumbnail (chosen image field + image style), the node title, and a prev/next label linking to the node. Two visual themes are shipped: a centred 'block' theme and a fixed slide-out 'wings' side-tabs theme. Per-block configuration: Previous Text, Next Text, Image Field, Image Style, Theme, Content Types, Taxonomy Terms, Maintain Term (keep the current node's term), Direction (forward = oldest-to-newest / backward), and End Behavior (loop, single, or current). Nodes must be tagged with one of the selected taxonomy terms and carry the selected image field for the block to appear. The installed 3.0.1 release ships only the block; the 3.1.0-beta line adds optional Views-integration sub-modules that are not present here.
